summary: 65-year-old woman was struck by lightning on the Ute Trail around midday, about 100 yards from the Trail Ridge Road trailhead roughly a mile above Rainbow Curve; responding rangers evacuated her with Estes Park EMS to Estes Park Medical Center; her condition was not known at the time of the report.
location: Ute Trail, Trail Ridge Road, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Estes Park EMS
